abstract: In 27 years, 64 patients were operated upon for ovarian lesions, 43 for tumors, 12 for nonneoplastic cysts and nine for ovarian torsion. Of all the girls in this age group who were operated upon for appendicitis, 2 percent had ovarian lesions. Of the girls referred for isosexual precocity in the last ten years, 4.7 per cent had ovarian lesions. Of the girls in this age group operated upon for malignant abdominal lesions, excluding hepatic, in the last 15 years, 10.8 per cent had ovarian tumors. Of the 11 tumors with endocrine function, four were malignant. This association is statistically significant. There were no operative deaths. There were no postoperative deaths among six patients with Stage I and II lesions. Mortality was confined to the two patients with Stage III and IV lesions. The surgical approach was designed to conserve ovarian tissue, and adjunctive chemotherapy and radiotherapy were infrequently used.
abstract_ja: 27年間にわたり、64例の患者が卵巣病変に対して手術を受けた。内訳は腫瘍43例、非腫瘍性嚢胞12例、卵巣捻転9例であった。同年齢層で虫垂炎の手術を受けた女児の2%に卵巣病変が認められた。思春期早発症の評価を受けた女児のうち4.7%に卵巣病変があった。過去15年間に、肝臓を除く悪性腹部病変の手術を受けたこの年齢層の女児のうち、10.8%に卵巣腫瘍があった。内分泌機能を有する11の腫瘍のうち4例が悪性であった。この関連は統計学的に有意であった。手術死亡はなかった。病期Iおよび病期IIの病変を有する6例では術後死亡はなかった。死亡は病期IIIおよびIVの2例に限られた。手術アプローチは卵巣組織の温存を目的として計画され、補助化学療法および放射線療法はまれにしか用いられなかった。
